about: P37B T1: 10 vět z různých rodin sloves pro klipy před/po. `heroAction` je hodnota z HERO_ACTIONS (src/play/spec.ts), kterou klipovač vepíše do specu hry, dokud ji neplní věta sama (P37A). Sloveso z klipu soudí T9 (≥ 7/10).

sentences.text: A chef stirs a bubbling pot of soup before the guests arrive
A gardener sprays the bugs off the roses
A builder stacks crates into a tall tower
A waiter carries plates across a crowded restaurant
A janitor sweeps the leaves off the school yard
A dog digs up hidden bones in the backyard
A painter paints every fence in the village
A lumberjack chops trees in a snowy forest
A gardener waters thirsty flowers before the sun dries them
A mechanic fixes broken robots in a factory
